nodes.name: Step 3 - Capacities
nodes.notes: teamId is deliberately null. With a teamId, effectiveAssignmentSettings applies that one team's caps to EVERY user in the list without checking membership, and caps are per-team and per-division, so a wrong team reads as zero capacity rather than erroring. Null resolves each user's own team(s); Distribute reconciles the one-row-per-(user,team) result by taking the lowest cap.

meta.description: v2 allocation: teams are containers; groups carry criteria and members. Matching is narrowest-group-wins. Ranking unchanged from v1. POST body.dryRun=true previews without assigning. Set body.gatewayBaseUrl to redirect every tool call, e.g. http://localhost:4000/api/tool for the local stand-in. Set body.fixtures to run entirely inside n8n with no reachable gateway, useful when n8n is remote and cannot see a local server.
